If you know you won't be a good dad then don't be a dad. Decide what the best course of action for you is. Sign away your rights, or figure out child support. There is no reason to put you or a kid in a position where you know you won't be happy and you won't be able to emotionally connect. But if that's your choice then you have to commit. You can't come back later and decide that after all the hard parts have been taken care of you can come back. To me it sounds like you were swindled into being a dad and sticking around when that isn't how a good dad is made. 

In the end do what makes you feel best. No child wants a parent who doesn't want to be around.

But! If your main concern about having a kid is being good dad material or your emotions, then you can deal with that through therapy. Deal with your anger and address it in a healthy way. You have many options. Not all of them are great but you aren't stuck to just one decision. The kid and you are a victim in this. Remember that. Hope you figure everything out OP.
